naya address batao
kya karna hai
theek hai
abhi bol
thoda wait karo

items.context: Kya main aapki delivery address badal doon?
items.text: han bolo

items.context: Kya aapko delivery kahin aur karwani hai?
items.text: nahi chahiye

items.context: Kab tak aapke address par delivery chahiye?
items.text: hame abhi chahiye
mera delivery address change karna hai kal tak
main chahta hu ki delivery mere office address pe ho
mera purana address se naya address alag hai please update karo
kya aap meri delivery ka address chandi chowk par badal sakte ho
landmark change karna hai mera naya address ke paas hai school
main third street se second street par apna order bhejna chahta hu
please meri delivery address ko update kar do jaldi se

items.context: Kya aap apna address specify kar sakte hain?
items.text: mera naya ghar main gaurav nagar me hai jadi update karna hai

items.context: Aapka naya delivery address kya hai?
items.text: naya address shop no 12 main bazaar ka samne hai
main chahta hu ki mera order kal subah delivery ho jaye

items.context: Kya aap apna landmark bata sakte hain?
items.text: mera landmark college ke samne hai jahan par deliver karna hai

items.context: Kya aap chahega ki main abhi address update kar doon?
items.text: mujhe jaldi se mera address update karwana hai aaj ke din
mera delivery address badalna hai abhi mera naya ghar sector 5 me hai kal tak delivery chahiye
main chahta hu ki mera order hospital ke andar wale gate ke paas deliver kiya jaye
please mera address change karo ye jo pehle tha wo galat hai main ab main market road me hoon ab

items.context: Aapka purana address kya hai aur naya address kya hai?
items.text: mera pehle ka address gali no 7 tha ab wo band ho gaya hai to main address mumbai colony sector 12 me badalna chahta hu

items.context: Details me bataye ki aapka naya address kahan hai?
items.text: maine jo order diya tha wo kahan deliver karwana tha wo meri building ke side wali chauraha ke paas tha lekin ab mera naya flat park view apartment me hai

items.context: Kya aap apna naya delivery landmark bata sakte hain?
items.text: main apna delivery landmark bhi change karna chahta hu pehle wo railway station ke samne tha ab wo school ke samne hai jiska naam st marys high school hai

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: delivery
Intent: change_address - wants to change the delivery address or landmark
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: plain and direct

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
